displacement_fraction.figure: Share of remediation hours the platform absorbs

faculty_hourly.source_template: MGMA 2025 Academic Compensation, associate professor, {basis} annual hours, {fringe} fringe. Eastern region only, so biased high by plausibly 10 to 20% against national.

marginal_cost.figure: Marginal cost of one extended training year
marginal_cost.source: AAMC stipends effective 1 July 2025 plus fringe. RAND: at an existing program, one more resident-year does not move GME infrastructure or IME cost.

modeled_extensions.figure: Modeled extensions per 100 trainees per year
modeled_extensions.source: Published remediation prevalence times Yao and Wright's 18% per-case additional training time. A modeled figure, not an ACGME statistic. Context only, never a dollar claim.

privacy_copy: Nothing you enter is sent anywhere. This calculator runs entirely in your browser.

hard_fees.scaling: two-tier at 5 residents only. A 40-resident program pays the same annual fee as a 6-resident one.
hard_fees.framing: These are the fees themselves, before a single hour of anyone's time. ClinicalSim does not claim to prevent them, and they are here only to give the rest of the panel a floor you can hold on to.

institutional_machinery.text: GMEC Special Review is mandatory for any program on Initial Accreditation with Warning, Continued Accreditation with Warning, or an adverse status, producing a timely report describing quality improvement goals, corrective actions, and the process for GMEC monitoring of outcomes including timelines.
The Annual Institutional Review must include each program's accreditation and recognition statuses and citations.
The GMEC must oversee the accreditation and recognition statuses of the Sponsoring Institution and each of its ACGME-accredited programs.

band_c_documented_properly.rationale: Base rates are published and precise. Cost of an adverse action is published nowhere, including in the only peer-reviewed probation case study. Attribution from a training tool to an avoided citation is not supportable. So: mechanism, frequency, and regulation numbers, with no dollar assigned.
band_c_documented_properly.renumbering_warning: The Sept 2025 Institutional Requirements replaced Roman numerals with decimals. Old IV.O.2 is now 4.15.b, I.B.4.a.(1) is 1.12.a, I.B.6 is 1.15.a. Citing old numbers reads as out of date to a DIO.
band_c_documented_properly.subhead: We are not going to put a number on this one. If you have run a GMEC Special Review, you already know what it cost you.

what_reviewers_examine.cite: ACGME, Guide to the Common Program Requirements, V.A.1 Resident Formative Evaluation Documentation
what_reviewers_examine.quote: Site visitors may verify the information provided through spot checks of resident files and interviews as needed. Reviewers look for evidence of multiple methods and multiple evaluators as well as alignment between the methods of assessment and the skill being assessed, and a structured mechanism with ongoing monitoring by a designated individual to ensure timely completion.

faculty_hourly_value.clinical_basis_warning: The 1456 denominator already excludes 360 hours of academic, teaching, administrative, and CME time. Applying it to hours that come out of that bucket double counts. Default to the 2080 basis and make the clinical basis opt-in.

discount_2_depth_of_substitution.basis: the platform shortens evidence gathering and defense, it does not remove the CCC meeting, the deliberation, or the ADS entry
discount_2_depth_of_substitution.supporting: Nabors et al., Arch Med Sci 2017;13(1):201-209: CCC deliberation fell 25 to 9 minutes per resident after process redesign, but that was a full committee-process overhaul rather than a data feed

discount_1_subcompetency_share.basis: roughly 6 to 7 of ~23 subcompetencies are ICS and professionalism

shortcut_finding.cite: Goyal et al., Med Educ Online 2018

comm_share.label: share of cases where a communication and professionalism tool is plausibly relevant

lever_a2_remediation_time.mechanism: Communication remediation runs on a roughly 20-minute unit, about 10 minutes of practice and 10 of faculty-led feedback. Faculty time does not scale, so the reps do not happen. The platform delivers practice and structured scoring on demand; faculty stay in the loop as coaches reviewing a dashboard. The value is hours redirected from facilitation to judgment, plus the reps the learner finally gets.
lever_a2_remediation_time.peer_comparison_line: 93% of programs have handled at least one communication or professionalism remediation case in the past three years. Most program leaders rate their current approach no better than moderately effective.

extension_evidence.labeling_requirement: Call this a MODELED extension rate derived from published remediation prevalence times published per-case extension probability. Never call it an ACGME statistic or a measured national rate. The single most defensible customer-facing sentence is the raw 18%: when an internal medicine program formally intervenes on a struggling resident, roughly one in five ends up needing additional training time.

lever_a4_gme_funding.chgme_copy: CHGME is a fixed appropriation rather than a per-resident entitlement, so a change in your weighted count moves your share of a pot that does not grow or shrink. That is why no dollar figure appears here.
lever_a4_gme_funding.other_copy: We do not model your funding stream. Enter your own per-FTE figure if you want it in the threshold.
lever_a4_gme_funding.over_cap_copy: An additional resident FTE draws no Medicare GME support at all, so an extended year is funded entirely from clinical revenue.
sharp_facts: IME applies no IRP weighting, so roughly 71% of Medicare GME dollars are indifferent to whether a resident has finished their initial residency period.
The cap counts unweighted FTEs, so a resident past their IRP consumes a full slot while generating half the DGME payment.
lever_a4_gme_funding.under_cap_copy: The three-year rolling average smooths when this lands in your cost report rather than removing it.
